question: Can all 100 frozen parents pass one uniform perception-asset contract after deterministic zero-area triangle sanitation and stage-correct train visualization?

failure_evidence.visualization_defect: All 37 M1 train previews were mislabeled M0 TRAIN ONLY by a reused hard-coded renderer.

method_change.sanitation: For every parent, after one native Cano materialization and before final sealing, compute triangle doubled area in float64 and remove all faces with doubled_area <= 1e-12 by deleting only their OBJ face lines. Preserve all vertex lines and coordinates exactly; do not move/remove vertices, fill holes, resample, remesh, retry or select outputs.
method_change.provenance: Record raw OBJ SHA-256, removed face count, triangle counts and surface area before/after; seal the sanitized OBJ as the sole downstream perception asset.
method_change.visualization: Use an explicit M1R TRAIN ONLY stage label. Render only the 80 train parents; render zero validation/development-test maps.
unchanged: same 100 frozen parents and manifest order
same pinned Cano generation path and geometry parameters
same exact source identity, axis, AABB and component checks

acceptance: 100/100 parents processed from scratch in frozen manifest order with exact source identity.
Every final sanitized OBJ has zero doubled-area<=1e-12 faces and passes all unchanged M1 individual quality checks.

Every sanitation record preserves raw hash and exact before/after counts; removed faces contribute only the predicate-bounded area, and reloaded final vertex coordinates have maximum difference exactly 0 from raw.
Exactly 100 unique final OBJ hashes, zero replay, 80 correctly labeled M1R train maps and zero non-train maps.
Any failure stops and seals FAIL; no retry, replacement, threshold change or continuation from failed M1 outputs.
Within 4 GiB and 3 hours on frozen E1 CPU.
reuse_policy: Generate all 100 M1R assets from scratch. M0F and failed M1 remain read-only evidence and are not copied into M1R.
claim_boundary: M1R would qualify sanitized perception assets only, not collision geometry, LiDAR, labels, a formal dataset, a model or a planner.

approval.scope: One M1R implementation and one formal full-100 execution with uniform zero-area sanitation, correct M1R train labels and zero downstream scope.
approval.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续 after receiving the sealed M1 failure review and exact M1R correction proposal.
